decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical BIOS disk structure and flags.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
MSBIO1, MSDISK, MSDIOCTL, MSBIO2 and other selected BIOS modules include msbds.inc.
Prior MSDISK and MSDIOCTL contributions match 1945 and 1733 target IO.SYS bytes respectively (reviews 012 and 011).
Prior MSBIO1 reconstruction sets the second logical drive initializer in its own source; its BIOS_DATA contribution then differs at only one later external pointer byte (review 008).
limitations: Prior comparisons cover the selected configuration and exercised fields, not all possible device configurations or final relocation values. Complete IO.SYS identity remains unverified.
